concerns.text: SC-004 lacks a quantitative threshold for what constitutes “reduced bias and improved coverage”. Without a concrete numeric target (e.g., bias reduction ≥ 20 % or coverage increase ≥ 5 pp), the criterion cannot be objectively measured.

SC-005 describes “stable conclusions” without defining a measurable bound (e.g., change in posterior means < 0.05 σ across prior‑width variations). The current wording is vague and therefore not verifiable.
